name: s81sp_capc_cl-v1-COMMIT
purpose: S81 die master dsfd_sp_capture_c as a cluster over the CLOSED M5 capture leaves (dsfd_capt_ctl/g2/x -m5-5b76815db); cluster logic = 872 station flops + t_cd; lockstep bench vs ctrl_c/dsfd_sp_capture_c.sv under the gather->capture golden

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_sp_capture_c u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl_c/dsfd_sp_capture_c_cl.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: capc_lockstep_exact
bench.cmd: bash tools/s81_ph/capc_bench.sh {RUN}/bench t1 'mix mix11 mix12 mix13 trace err over range rreq'

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sp_capc_cl/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sp_capc_cl/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sp_capc_cl --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_sp_capture_c --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_ctl_m5/views/dsfd_capt_ctl --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_g2_m5/views/dsfd_capt_g2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_x_m5/views/dsfd_capt_x > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
